svg.title: Where Beacon runs
svg.desc: Beacon's code runs on the app platform; its data and the models run beside it, each deployed its own way.

g.text: opens a ticket · nothing reaches Beacon without a signed-in agent
forwards with the agent's token · the API acts as the agent, never as a service account
asks for a draft · drafting is the only call
that leaves the platform's trust boundary
Deployed by CI on every merge
checks identity, forwards the agent's token
